newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse ends weaker on election nerves.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse ends weaker on election nerves.

text.p: French stocks fell on Tuesday on polls suggesting a close parliamentary election between the ruling conservatives and the Socialists, brokers said.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed down 20.91 points, or 0.78 percent, at 2,651.93 after losing its early gains triggered by a sharp rise on Wall Street on Monday.
Brokers said investors were in a mood to take profits after the CAC's 5.4 percent gain in the last five sessions.
Of the CAC-40 stocks, eight rose and 32 closed lower.
The broader SBF-120 index fell 11.99 to 1,844.02.
